items.sentence: Do you think the reason will ever be known why Stonehenge, a prehistoric monument located in southwestern England, was made?
items.prompt: why Stonehenge ... was made가 의미상 수식하는 선행사를 입력하세요.
items.explanation: why절은 바로 앞에 붙어 있지 않지만 the reason을 수식합니다. 짧은 술부 will ever be known 뒤로 관계절이 이동한 구조입니다.

items.sentence: Do you think the reason will ever be known why Stonehenge, a prehistoric monument located in southwestern England, was made?

items.sentence: The result of the struggle for existence, natural selection, is that animals and plants sustain themselves which are best fitted to the life they have to lead, while species die out that are less fitted.
items.prompt: 앞의 명사를 수식하지만 술부 뒤로 이동한 두 관계사절을 앞에서부터 차례로 선택하세요.
answers: which are best fitted to the life they have to lead
items.explanation: which절은 animals and plants를, that절은 species를 수식합니다. 긴 관계사절이 각각 sustain themselves와 die out 뒤에 놓인 형태입니다.
